resources.title: Computer Networking Introduction - Kurose & Ross Companion

practice_tasks: Implement basic array and linked list operations from scratch in your preferred language.
Solve 3 easy-level array/string problems on LeetCode.
Use Wireshark or browser developer tools to inspect HTTP request and response headers for a live website.
Study stacks, queues, and basic recursion; solve 3 related problems on LeetCode.
Design the resource endpoints (URL paths, HTTP methods, status codes) for a simple Blog API.
Build a basic CRUD REST API using Express.js (or Flask/FastAPI) with in-memory data storage.

resources.title: Introduction to TDD by Martin Fowler

practice_tasks: Learn basic sorting algorithms (Bubble, Merge, Quick) and hash tables; solve 3 hash table problems.
Write unit tests for the CRUD REST API built in Week 2 using a testing framework like Jest or PyTest, following a basic TDD approach.

focus_skills: Caching Strategies and Message Queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
practice_tasks: Solve 3 basic binary tree or graph traversal problems on LeetCode.
Set up a local MongoDB instance and connect your REST API to perform persistent document storage.
Implement a simple Redis caching layer for one of your API endpoints to reduce database read frequency.

resources.title: AWS Skill Builder Free Digital Training

practice_tasks: Write a Dockerfile for your REST API project, building an image and running it successfully in a local container.
Explore an AWS cloud platform console, create a free-tier account, and review core services (IAM, EC2, S3).
Use Docker Compose to run your REST API container alongside a MongoDB container together locally.
Create a GitHub Actions CI workflow that automatically triggers unit tests on every pull request or push to your repository.
